set.body: Owner-commissioned 2026-10-25 ("go ahead and do the whole thing… exceptionally good and efficient at facilitating recall to video mapping"). A local, keyboard-first workbench for human recall-to-video mapping and attribution review. Its first use is the identity experiment's human references (owner decisions op 20261025T174031.593362Z-p20738-c0000-r7f9b-h1e09a1); a port to storyatlas4s (Laminar) comes later. Plan: docs/plans/2026-10-25-recall-review-workbench.md (branch claude/review-ui-plan, 5086df383). Constraints: local only with a token-gated loopback server; blind to arm outputs; the source pass precedes and is kept apart from the recall pass; writes Codex's exact decisions.csv and review-windows.csv interchange plus an append-only log; bound to the frozen census hashes.
set.title: [review-workbench] Recall review workbench (local recall-to-video mapping and attribution review)
